title: Andy's Smoky Chipotle Chuck Roast
ingredients: 480 ml beef broth & 60 ml olive oil
30 g tomato paste & 120 ml tomato purée
5 cloves garlic, mashed & 1 sliced white onion
Spice blend: 8 g cumin, 6 g smoked paprika, 4.5 g oregano, 3 g chili powder, 5 g salt, 3 g cinnamon
15 ml soy sauce & 40 g dark chocolate
steps: Preheat your oven to 160°C to prepare for slow cooking the seasoned beef roast in a Dutch oven.
Sear the 1.5-1.8 kg beef chuck roast in 60 ml olive oil inside a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until well browned on all sides.
Whisk together the beef broth, chipotles, adobo sauce, tomato paste, tomato purée, lime juice, honey, garlic, and onion.
Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili powder, salt, cinnamon, soy sauce, and dark chocolate until blended.
Pour the smoky tomato sauce over the browned chuck roast and cover the Dutch oven tightly with a lid.
Transfer to the preheated oven and bake at 160°C for 3 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
